description: This file defines data types, constants, macros, and external interfaces for the 'ifxmips_mei' driver, related to Infineon Technologies' MIPS-based ADSL hardware interface. It includes platform-specific configurations, register offsets, data structures for device management, and IOCTL command definitions.

classes.name: ifx_mei_device_private_t
classes.description: Internal kernel structure for managing the device state, including message buffers, memory info, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: DSL_DEV_WinHost_Message_t
classes.description: Structure for messages exchanged with the WinHost, containing union of receive and transmit message arrays.

classes.name: DSL_DEV_MeiDebug_t
classes.description: Structure for debug data, including address, count, and buffer for debug reads/writes.

classes.name: struct_meireg
classes.description: Structure for debug register access, specifying address and data.

classes.name: _arc_swp_page_hdr
classes.description: Header for a swap page, describing memory offsets and sizes for program and data segments.

classes.name: _arc_img_hdr
classes.description: Header for a swap image, including size, checksum, count, and page headers.

classes.name: smmu_mem_info_t
classes.description: Structure describing memory info for SMMU, including type, size, and addresses.

methods.name: DSL_BSP_DriverHandleGet
methods.description: External function to get device handle.

methods.name: DSL_BSP_DriverHandleDelete
methods.description: External function to delete device handle.

methods.name: DSL_BSP_FWDownload
methods.description: External function to perform firmware download.

methods.name: DSL_BSP_KernelIoctls
methods.description: External function to perform kernel IOCTLs.

methods.name: DSL_BSP_SendCMV
methods.description: External function to send CMV messages.

methods.name: DSL_BSP_AdslLedInit
methods.description: External function to initialize ADSL LED.

methods.name: DSL_BSP_ATMLedCBRegister
methods.description: External function to register LED callback.

methods.name: DSL_BSP_MemoryDebugAccess
methods.description: External function for memory debug access.
